_comment: Cross-repo mobile capability contract. Byte-identical copies live in this repo at api/mobile/capability_contract.json and in the PM site at lib/mobile/capability-contract.json. Each repo asserts its own ROLE_CAPABILITIES map against this file, so an asymmetric edit fails one repo's suite instead of shipping silent drift. digest = sha256 of json.dumps(capabilities, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')).
